source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Parsed source object points, counted matching image observations from TiePoints.txt, and transformed positions into Case Study B scene coordinates using the sampled TLS preview transform.

sceneTransform.note: Object points are centered and lifted with the same transform as the sampled TLS preview.

reviewStatus.notes: This sparse object-point preview is source-derived QA context for photogrammetry. It is not a dense reconstruction, orthomosaic, DSM, or final mesh.
